finding: A safe but non-action title caused the ordinary first-layer fallback to discard an independently supported summary.

firstFixAttempt.finding: A partner field could borrow all result meaning from the fallback and incorrectly replace the existing missing-result behavior.

correction: Retained wording must independently satisfy the existing usefulness gate; the combined Story still undergoes full authority validation. No additional model call or global cache invalidation.
limitations: Synthetic model contract; not production Sol acceptance.
The first red invocation had an unsuccessful GH isolation-directory lookup; its synthetic Fact fixture did not use a Git repository. The corrected runs used the existing isolated directory.
